generatorFeedback.description: CARRY FORWARD TO SPRINT 8. The negative control's new comment claims mutating 2 cases is safe 'regardless of how many more cases the replay set grows to hold'. That is false for a FIXED mutation count against a GROWING denominator: (n-2)/n crosses the 80% threshold at n=11 (9/11 = 81.8%). dataset.test.ts and gate.test.ts switched to a modulo strategy that scales; executor.test.ts hardcodes two caseIds. Not a defect today — mutation-tested and correctly failing at n=6 — but it will silently stop biting at 11 replay cases, the same class of break this sprint had to fix at 6.
generatorFeedback.expected: Either correct the comment to state the real breakpoint (n=11), or switch to a mutation count that scales with replayCases.length, matching the other two files.
